title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 180B — unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL on one RTX 4090 (hybrid MoE offload)
slug_note: 40 expert layers on the GPU, the rest streamed from 110GB of DDR4: 22.5 tok/s decode and 384 tok/s prefill at 80k context from a single 24GB card.

engine.config: llama.cpp built from PR #27742 (danielhanchen qwen-next branch — required for this architecture), CUDA, sm_86. -ncmoe 40 keeps 40 expert MoE layers on the GPU and streams the rest from system RAM; --fit off is required (auto-fitting mis-sizes this architecture); -b/-ub 4096 roughly doubles prompt ingestion.

requirements.notes: 23.85GB VRAM + ~97GB host RAM resident at 80k ctx. Host: Ubuntu 22, CUDA 13.0, PCIe 4.0 x16, 110GB DDR4.

steps.text: Download the 4 UD-Q4_K_XL shards from unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF

measurements.note: -ncmoe 40 @80k ctx, 28k continuous prompt, no MTP/no dflash/no KV quant; 23.85GB VRAM + 97GB RAM
-b 4096 -ub 4096 doubles ingestion from ~150 to 364+ t/s per author

caveats: Method: continuous 28k-token prompt per run; 250k figures elsewhere in the thread are a configured window, not prompt length.
No MTP/dflash/KV-quant in these runs — author: spec-decode recipes 'not yet', and doubts they would double throughput with RAM offload.
Third-party reply (@foley2k2) gets 26-30 tok/s on Q3_XL — smaller quant trades context headroom for speed.
Author's same-hardware comparisons: DeepSeek V4 Flash Q4 ~12 tps, Poolside Laguna S 2.1 (118B MoE) Q4 ~12 tps — this lane is roughly double.
